gapThisFills: 2026-09-28 acquisition queue, one of four Drew ordered same day. sourcePageShape: Baseball Almanac's one-set checklist page (baseball_cards_oneset.php?s=1987don02) lists a bare 'NUMBER. Player Name' line per card, #1-56, with #56 printed as 'Checklist' (the set's own numbered checklist card, not a player). Cross-checked in full against BaseballCardPedia's 1987 Donruss The Rookies article (same 56 rows, XRC annotations for extended-rookie-card players, #56 also listed as the checklist card) and Wax Pack Gods' set guide (same 56 rows and note). All three sources agree on every row; minor spelling variants across sources (e.g. Ken Williams/Kenny Williams, Mike Jackson/Michael Jackson, Bill Ripken/Billy Ripken, James Steels/Jim Steels) were resolved to BaseballCardPedia's spelling as this package's primary transcription source, cross-referenced against Baseball Almanac.
converterNote: Rows transcribed by hand from the fetched checklist text (no HTML scraper script needed for a 56-row page): number and player name copied verbatim per source, category stamped 'insert-the-rookies' uniformly (no base tier exists in this file -- see heldOut), isAuto=false and printRun blank for every row (no source states either), parallel left blank (no named parallel is claimed by any of the three sources for this set).

sectionsReport.note: OWN numbering for the entire boxed set, 1-55 (see heldOut for #56). This is a standalone dealer-only factory set distributed in its own small green-and-black box, never packed with or numbered against the 660-card 1987 Donruss flagship, and its numbers DO overlap the flagship's own 1-660 range (this set's #14 is Bo Jackson; the flagship's #14 is Kevin McReynolds DK -- confirmed by reading acq-2026-09-13-bcp/1987-donruss-baseball.csv on this branch). Resolved by the 2026-09-28 setKeyRuling: this file's rows key to the registered 'donruss-the-rookies' address, distinct from the flagship's bare 'donruss' address, so the shared card numbers no longer clash.

heldOut.reason: Not a player card -- all three sources list #56 as the checklist card itself, the same shape as the 1985 Donruss sibling package's excluded 'NNO Diamond Kings Checklist' filler cards. No player name to key an identity on. Held out rather than staged as e.g. player='Checklist', per the same exclusion rule as that sibling package.
